more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 172.820, checked in 2026.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain food supplements supplied in a solid form, excluding food supplements for infants and young children; table-top sweeteners in powder form.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.origin: A synthetic polymer formed from ethylene oxide and water. The US provision covers mean molecular weights from 200 to 9,500.
more_info.overview: Polyethylene glycol 8000 is a high-molecular-weight grade of ethylene oxide polymer; the number denotes an approximate average molecular weight rather than one identical molecule. Its carrier role is to dissolve, dilute or distribute another food ingredient in a preparation. A synthetic polymer formed from ethylene oxide and water. The US provision covers mean molecular weights from 200 to 9,500. The 8000 grade is a white or almost white wax-like solid that is very soluble in water.
